### Asana Plans & Pricing (per user, per month)

- **Personal** (Free forever):
	- **Cost:** $0 (supports up to 2 users)
	- **Features:** Unlimited tasks and projects, list/board/calendar views, and 100MB file storage limit.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiuVJRnm4RMnc2KvLq2Wi-c8ViTgmwLJDwDtkCFAvZfMse_mIWjrAEwDwFdzGhHvmc3YKUQJv1rT9vHyLcFioOgaV3w-SCuLQ-aXD_F1pt44k)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXSlkDlom6cFacARu_Dh62LVkkEgCxPyVDGu5Vwd-iyiTcElxLCzQZo4HyfcJizMb7SBxcSq3wKcxo5xtFrve94IDrzaED7-wZYMavSVLcK5G3ScdP7ziNyrTSIPsttA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXX1W7M3WEFvDrY5Xqg2dhHIZg7InfN_y6vh2PUiQyFgMkg9-WiHm4rSr4aIlkjfdr11svaAuUbnHbWRllQA8kkZqIly6qbhUGiA_07AuEUFetyXfYiNffZjTsrzePe82oLVKmZz3hJ9iaCudc)
- **Starter**:
	- **Cost:** **$10.99 per user/month** (billed annually) or **$13.49 per user/month** (billed monthly).
	- **Features:** Timeline and Gantt views, custom fields, unlimited automations, and AI Studio basic credits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXX1W7M3WEFvDrY5Xqg2dhHIZg7InfN_y6vh2PUiQyFgMkg9-WiHm4rSr4aIlkjfdr11svaAuUbnHbWRllQA8kkZqIly6qbhUGiA_07AuEUFetyXfYiNffZjTsrzePe82oLVKmZz3hJ9iaCudc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXCvTUZ6r9-Pyzci0kFZHl88SV-06JUoVnCwVwV5aJqqEwmp-O-YnOOT11QEEATmq67_9NzU0lpSOXicMys-pEH64lD2jSjJ_WZ1d-X1GFWFgH5QieIccymKAdRWNMvAM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiuVJRnm4RMnc2KvLq2Wi-c8ViTgmwLJDwDtkCFAvZfMse_mIWjrAEwDwFdzGhHvmc3YKUQJv1rT9vHyLcFioOgaV3w-SCuLQ-aXD_F1pt44k)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXQXuA235zW_vG3-k6NIBYvs1QcofdTGXJKXOzPa9i9YaMp6uSX9KYb1A7QCn3Ryrxsnpp5b6wsYz1_go3aQ3knUJcOUY4yhOgXIR1xDnpn1X3Nlit20TsSjNwGM0nfISv)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXcwwY2qmp5KD7msNeUr70wVgjgJnQBntYpSfFnYtzqxem0_1Y6tOYq3A_9XyZSjttg5k8wrR6IfBBVs3ur8Euz4P57zeiblY5UBsrxDfdNi4eyEd814Mm0djrTYIw_ttkKHZ3pEu3sKg)
- **Advanced**:
	- **Cost:** **$24.99 per user/month** (billed annually) or **$30.49 per user/month** (billed monthly).
	- **Features:** Portfolios, goals, resource management, AI meetings, and expanded AI Studio credits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiuVJRnm4RMnc2KvLq2Wi-c8ViTgmwLJDwDtkCFAvZfMse_mIWjrAEwDwFdzGhHvmc3YKUQJv1rT9vHyLcFioOgaV3w-SCuLQ-aXD_F1pt44k)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXCvTUZ6r9-Pyzci0kFZHl88SV-06JUoVnCwVwV5aJqqEwmp-O-YnOOT11QEEATmq67_9NzU0lpSOXicMys-pEH64lD2jSjJ_WZ1d-X1GFWFgH5QieIccymKAdRWNMvAM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXQXuA235zW_vG3-k6NIBYvs1QcofdTGXJKXOzPa9i9YaMp6uSX9KYb1A7QCn3Ryrxsnpp5b6wsYz1_go3aQ3knUJcOUY4yhOgXIR1xDnpn1X3Nlit20TsSjNwGM0nfISv)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXcwwY2qmp5KD7msNeUr70wVgjgJnQBntYpSfFnYtzqxem0_1Y6tOYq3A_9XyZSjttg5k8wrR6IfBBVs3ur8Euz4P57zeiblY5UBsrxDfdNi4eyEd814Mm0djrTYIw_ttkKHZ3pEu3sKg)

	- **Cost:** Custom pricing (contact sales).
